title: Topology - Of a Slow Collapse
description:
Recorded live by myself and two other friends. This album was done using hardware synths, a mixer, a sampler, various acoustic instruments, and tons of effect pedals. I, myself, played synth, guitar, hi-hat, and lots of mixer manipulation as we took advantage of effect sends to transform our collective sound. My personal favorite is track two. 

In addition this was my first time ever recording and mixing something. This was recorded at ACC in Studio A. There are a million things I'd do differently when recording again and another million when mixing, but I'm still happy with it being my first experience. 

 For fans of: Noise, Ambient, Post-Rock, Avant-Garde, Field Recordings, and Experimental music.
